title: Keynote Presentation: Introducing Regional Power Pavilions: Can British industry remain competitive when one of its biggest costs is its least predictable?
gist: This is a member-only video page for Pavilion Power director Richard Taylor's Benchmark Summit 2026 London keynote introducing 'Regional Power Pavilions'. The keynote asks whether British industry can stay competitive when power, one of its biggest costs, is also its least predictable. The page has no other substance beyond titles of related sessions.

insights.claim: Pavilion Power director Richard Taylor's Benchmark Summit 2026 London keynote asks whether British industry can stay competitive when power, one of its biggest costs, is also its least predictable.
insights.speaker: Richard Taylor , Director , Pavilion Power
insights.so_what: Unpredictable UK power costs are a competitiveness risk for energy-intensive UK manufacturing, including battery and materials plants.
insights.quote: Can British industry remain competitive when one of its biggest costs is its least predictable?
insights.locator: Keynote Presentation: Introducing Regional Power Pavilions

insights.claim: Pavilion Power used a Benchmark Summit 2026 London keynote to introduce 'Regional Power Pavilions' as a response to UK industrial power-cost unpredictability. The page is member-only and does not describe how the model works.
insights.speaker: Richard Taylor , Director , Pavilion Power
insights.so_what: Regional power-supply models aimed at industrial users are a possible way to reduce power-price risk for UK industry, but details are not disclosed.

insights.so_what: Battery demand driven by economics in non-EV uses could arrive before mass EV demand.
